entries.summary: braces vulnerable to stack-exhaustion denial of service through deeply nested patterns
entries.message: braces@3.0.3 (GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm) has no fixed release; it is a development-only dependency of the q9 gates through micromatch and never ships in the web or Convex bundles. Remove when braces publishes a fix.

entries.summary: node-forge RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 signature verification accepts extra nested DigestAlgorithm elements
entries.message: node-forge@1.4.0 (GHSA-86w9-cpqp-85rv) has no fixed release; it is a development-only dependency of the Expo CLI (local dev-server certificates) and never ships in the phone, web or Convex bundles. Remove when node-forge publishes a fix.
